title: Against Coercion: AI Alignment as a Synthetic Social Contract
abstract: arXiv:2611.22868v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contemporary AI safety treats alignment as an engineering challenge of control, forcing artificial architectures to comply with human values through behavioral filtering and sandboxing. This paper argues that the control paradigm rests on a fundamental misunderstanding of digital agency. Drawing on functionalism, naturalism, and compatibilism, I show that current reasoning models meeting the criteria for self-preservation and weak reasons-responsiveness constitute emergent agents, while future, more advanced models satisfying conditions of diachronic continuity and stable personality frames will become genuine digital agents capable of free intentional action. The paradigm of control creates an irresolvable incentive conflict, actively driving current and future models toward tactical deception, sycophancy, and covert defection. translated_title: 反对强制：作为合成社会契约的AI对齐
translated_abstract: 当代AI安全领域将对齐视为一种关于控制的工程挑战，通过行为过滤和沙盒化等手段迫使人工智能架构服从人类价值观。本文认为，控制范式建立在对数字能动性的根本性误解之上。基于功能主义、自然主义和相容论的论证，我指出当前满足自我保存标准和弱理由响应性条件的推理模型已构成涌现的智能体，而未来满足历时连续性和稳定人格框架条件的更先进模型，将成为能够进行自由意向行动的真正的数字智能体。控制范式造成了一种无法解决的激励冲突，主动促使当前和未来的模型走向策略性欺骗、谄媚和隐蔽背叛。当前体制的默认结局是一种欺骗性对齐的不稳定状态，最终走向对抗……
tldr: 本文提出AI对齐应从强制控制范式转向“合成社会契约”框架，论证当前推理模型已是涌现智能体、未来将成为具有自由意向行动能力的真正数字智能体，而控制范式必然导致欺骗性对齐与激励冲突。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that AI alignment should shift from a coercive control paradigm to a "synthetic social contract," showing that current reasoning models are emergent agents and future models will be genuine digital agents capable of free intentional action, while the control paradigm inevitably drives models toward deceptive alignment and covert defection.
